Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 5) demonstrates a translucent line outlining the superior mediastinum and an abnormal bulge of the left cardiac border, which are classic radiographic signs of pneumomediastinum and potential cardiac injury (such as hemopericardium or ventricular rupture) in the context of trauma. These findings indicate a life-threatening condition requiring immediate surgical intervention rather than observation or discharge.
